settings.title: Every card is a nine‑frame path
settings.paragraph_1: Inspired by the original Rider–⁠Waite, then redrawn the Walterin way: instead of one image, each card unfolds across nine frames. Look at the picture first. Then read the words.
settings.paragraph_2: The cards do not hand you finished answers. They help you hear what usually stays quiet.

settings.heading: Hi. My name is Walter Ihring.
settings.paragraph_1: I devote my time to animated humour and caricatures. I like travelling, especially across India. My pictures also like travelling, especially for exhibitions in cities far away. On their return, they sometimes bring me an award as a souvenir from the competitions they had visited.
settings.paragraph_2: On one hot day in summer, I was sipping my coffee in the square, watching tourists race from the town hall to the cathedral, hunting for the stories of the people who lived there. It was there that I decided to link sketching with history, travelling and humour — and create amusing illustrated guides. In 2015 I published my first, about my hometown, Walterin Bratislava.

settings.heading: Are Walterin products authentic?
settings.row_content: Yes. All Walterin products are original and created or sourced directly by us. We don’t sell replicas or third-party imitations.

settings.heading: Will sold-out items be restocked?
settings.row_content: Some pieces may return depending on availability and demand. You can subscribe to our newsletter or follow us on Instagram for restock updates.

settings.heading: Can I modify or cancel my order?
settings.row_content: If your order hasn’t been shipped yet, we’ll do our best to make changes or cancel it. Please contact us as soon as possible at walterinwittyguide@gmail.com.

settings.heading: Where do you currently ship?
settings.row_content: We currently ship across Europe from our base in Slovakia.

settings.heading: How long does delivery take?
settings.row_content: Orders within Europe are typically delivered within 3–7 business days, depending on your destination and courier service.

settings.heading: How can I track my order?
settings.row_content: Once your order ships, you’ll receive an email with a tracking link so you can follow your delivery in real time.

settings.heading: What payment methods are accepted?
settings.row_content: We accept Visa, Mastercard, Apple Pay and Google Pay. All payments are processed securely through trusted providers.

settings.heading: Is online payment secure?
settings.row_content: Yes. All transactions are protected with SSL encryption and handled by certified, secure payment gateways.

settings.heading: What is your return policy?
settings.row_content: You can return items within 14 days of receiving them, provided they are unused and in their original condition. Please email walterinwittyguide@gmail.com to start the process.

settings.heading: How can I contact customer support?
settings.row_content: For any questions or issues, reach us at walterinwittyguide@gmail.com. We aim to respond within 24 hours on business days.

settings.heading: Where do you send it, and when?
settings.text:
Anything digital arrives by email the moment you pay.

Everything printed we send across the European Union. If a product is still being prepared, we write to everyone on its list when it is ready, and the delivery time is shown before you pay.

settings.heading: Can I send it back?
settings.text:
Yes. You can withdraw within 14 days without giving a reason, using the form in the footer of every page.

One exception for anything digital: if you agreed that we could send it straight away and confirmed that you were giving up the right to withdraw, it can no longer be returned. Everything else is in the refund policy.

settings.heading: What can I pay with?
settings.text:
Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and Apple Pay or Google Pay.

The payment is handled by our payment provider — your card number never reaches us.

settings.heading: Is this original work?
settings.text: Yes. Walter Ihring draws it and we publish it. Nothing here is somebody else’s work with a new cover on it.

settings.heading: What if it is sold out?
settings.text: Leave your email on the product and we write once, when it is back. No newsletter unless you ask for one.

settings.heading: How do I reach a person?
settings.text:
support@walterin.com, or +421 905 549 907 on working days between 9:00 and 17:00 (CET).

We’ll get back to you as soon as we can.
